d.ko: Gods. Romance. Murder. Musical Numbers?! Play as Grace in a world where Greek Gods live in hiding among us. Change your fate as you draw friends, foes & lovers into song using your powers of musical persuasion to unravel the mystery of the Last Muse's death.
d.en: Gods. Romance. Murder. Musical Numbers?! Play as Grace in a world where Greek Gods live in hiding among us. Change your fate as you draw friends, foes & lovers into song using your powers of musical persuasion to unravel the mystery of the Last Muse's death.
d.zh: 神明、爱情、凶杀，还有音乐剧？！在这个世界里，希腊诸神隐匿凡间；而你将扮演格蕾丝，以感人肺腑的乐声，将好友、敌手与爱人通通带入你的音乐世界，从而改变你的命运，揭开“最后一位缪斯”的死亡之谜。
